name: XLA_BAL_PERIOD_STATS_GT
description: This table is used by the balance calculation program to store the status of accounting period.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Fiscal period that reports financial results, such as a calendar month or fiscal period.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Fiscal year a company uses to report financial results.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the latest period for which the opening of the balances has been completed successfully for the ledger, application and balance source.

columns.name: FIRST_PERIOD_IN_YEAR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether it is the first period in the year.
